blocks.text: Welcome to Album Trader! This guide walks you through the basics: tracking your collection, finding trades, and using the community tab.
Open the Collection tab and tap each card you already own. Your progress bar fills in as you go — no need to save, it's automatic.
The Community tab shows other players and highlights cards you can trade with them: what they can give you, and what you can give them.
Send a trade request from the Community tab, wait for the other player to accept, then mark it done once you've exchanged in-game. Your collections update automatically.
